cue: Extending a subcritical exponential estimate to p_c, or using q=p(1-m_h(p)) to approach criticality
fire_when: A proof takes p to p_c from a fixed-p decay estimate, or assumes q_h tends to p_c without checking m_h(p_c).
silent_when: The proof fixes p strictly below p_c and keeps its parameter-dependent constants, or explicitly assumes and separately proves the needed endpoint premise.
text: Check the full parameter range before passing decay to p_c. Finite-box continuity does not justify swapping p and radius limits. For q_h=p_c(1-m_h(p_c)), q_h->p_c already requires theta(p_c)=0; a uniform positive exponential rate is also unavailable.
